facts.business: Bazel International Limited is a registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in providing advances and earning interest income.

auditor.name: M/s Krishna Rakesh & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding non-receipt of interest income from two parties to whom advances were made during FY 2025-26, and non-classification of said exposures as sub-standard assets with no provision made @ 10%, based on management's representation of proposed conversion into equity investment and expectation of recovery in FY 2026-27.

key_risks: Non-receipt of interest income from borrowers
Non-classification of advances as sub-standard assets despite non-receipt of interest
Reliance on management representation for asset classification and provisioning
